non_goals: It does not replace professional accountants, tax consultants or financial advisors.
It does not provide automated GST filing, income tax filing or tax-return submission.
It does not connect directly to bank accounts or access banking credentials.
It does not initiate payments, transfer money or process transactions.
It does not generate legally binding invoices or guarantee tax compliance.
It does not guarantee that clients will pay outstanding invoices.
It does not provide investment, loan or credit recommendations.
It does not support complex enterprise accounting or multi-company financial management.
It does not automatically send payment reminders without user approval.
It does not depend on paid AI APIs or require users to purchase subscriptions to access core financial features.
one_line_summary: A financial co-pilot that helps freelancers track invoices, expenses and pending payments, and plan their cash flow.
